index.scope: Port EVERY function/helper in src/svg/index/index.c/h against accepted XmlReader, XmlTokenStream and TaskQueue. Safe IndexSession borrows immutable caller Arc<Vec<u8>> for lifetime: reader borrows caller bytes while validation worker clones Arc, avoiding self-referential struct, unsafe borrowed thread pointers or unconditional entire-source copy. Source bytes unchanged; no smaller source cap. Full owner lexical scan plus actual independent background bounded validation, start/step/progress/generation/preview/currentness/cancel/elements/tokens/synthetic preview/drop. Preserve1GiBsource/64KiBmaxstep/1Melements/1Mattributes/256depth/256MiBstorage with128MiBcomponent budgets; charge actual reserved metadata/token storage. Preserve original support subset/root/attribute gate, first completed supported rect/path preview and validation frontier gate, exact diagnostics/error precedence, no tokens until full validation, generation invalidation and owned <=16MiB synthetic preview bytes. Shutdown cancels/joins worker before shared buffers release; successfulworker result ownership/atomic visibility correct and error storage not partially exposed. Accepted taskqueue callbacks always run after Running even canceled: validator polls token and cannot publish canceled/stale results. No placeholder synchronous validation/thread-blocking join per step or scan-then-whole-parse substitute. Port meaningful original index cases: incremental budget/progress, previews versus malformed prefix/tail, unsupported root/attrs, generation, cancellation, full token source spans, nested parent/source spans, resource bounds and teardown. Deterministic bounded worker wait seams allowed, no timing-only flaky tests/huge perf campaign. UI/index progress and renderer integration later; index alone does not prove large-file performance.

document-model.scope: Port EVERY function/helper in src/document/document_model.c/h. Safe lifetime-bound DocumentModel borrows immutable original source bytes, retains no edits/normalization and uses accepted real bounded XmlTokenStream, with64MiB actual allocated tokenizer storage cap, 1Mnodes/256depth, exact parse diagnostic and resource exhaustion/error mapping. Safe owned bounded node/attribute tables preserve root/parent/child/sibling/depth/tag/attribute/source-spans/node-at/count queries and subtree removal. DocumentHandle{document_id:u64,slot:u32,generation:u32} rejects wrong/stale/deleted/cross-model handles. Native atomic document IDs monotonic, fail before wrapping/reusing0/MAX; safe isolated deterministic exhaustion seam without weakening real production IDs. Source spans encompass complete closing tag/empty element and raw names/values preserve unknown prefixes/editor metadata. Removed subtree generations/livecounts/child-sibling traversal/root removal match reference; stale handles cannot resolve. Port all meaningful original tests/source exact bytes/spans/UTF8/DOCTYPE/comments/unknown metadata, parse failure categories/offsets, limits/resource behavior, wrong handles/delete parent/live counts/lifetimes and IDs. Fallible significant allocations and checked sizes, no public fabricated parse-success hooks. No source-edit/history/piece table implementation in this order; those depend on accepted model contract next, not product omission.
